title: Expanded Summoning Sprint 18: Ape and Dire Ape
status: CONTRACT FROZEN; NOT IMPLEMENTED; NOT QUALIFIED

authority.primarySource: Official Pathfinder Bestiary Ape entry (Gorilla, Gigantopithecus) and the official Summon Monster / Summon Nature's Ally tables.
authority.rule: Mechanics are transcribed from the printed stat block and the official tables only. Flavour prose, donor units, planning shorthand and test expectations are not authorities. Anything the implementation cannot deliver exactly is raised against this record rather than quietly adapted.
authority.masterDelta: NONE. origin/master is exactly the v0.0.146 tag target at intake.
authority.scope: Sprint 18 only. Girallon, Xill, Giant Scorpion, Bebelith, Giant Crab, Sprint 19 and any broader phase are out of scope on this branch.

placement.derivedFrom: src/KingmakerGunslinger/Summoning/ExpandedSummoningCatalog.cs quantity semantics (own tier single, one tier lower 1d3, everything lower 1d4+1) evaluated for parent tiers 1-9.
placement.templatePolicy: Existing Summon Monster celestial/fiendish template policy. Both creatures are animals, so each Summon Monster placement also owns its Celestial and Fiendish execution abilities; Summon Nature's Ally placements are untemplated.
placement.suppressionPlan: Both creature keys are suppressed in SummonVisibilityCatalog from registration until the complete hidden candidate passes. Identities are allocated once at registration and are never reallocated at publication.

derivations.attackBonus: BAB +2 plus Strength +2 minus Large size 1 = +3 on each slam.
derivations.slamDamage: Full Strength modifier on each slam because both are primary natural attacks: 1d6+2 at Strength 15.
derivations.fortitude: Animal 3 HD good Fortitude +3, Constitution +2, Great Fortitude +2 = +7.
derivations.reflex: Animal 3 HD good Reflex +3 plus Dexterity +2 = +5.
derivations.will: Animal 3 HD poor Will +1 plus Wisdom +1 = +2.
derivations.combatManeuverDefense: 10 + BAB 2 + Strength 2 + Dexterity 2 + Large size 1 = 17; no trip-defence carrier is printed or implemented.
derivations.reach: Space 10 feet with Reach 10 feet is the ordinary Large footprint, so no reduced-reach carrier is used.

implementationConsequences: No invented chest-thump fear effect and no roar ability.
Climb movement is omitted under the ordinary-map land-use scope; Kingmaker exposes one movement speed and the project has no faithful bounded native climb carrier.
Low-light vision and scent are omitted under OwnerAcceptedEngineLimitation: PASSIVE_CREATURE_SENSES_UNMODELED. Nothing is substituted, and no blindsense or vision-range override is granted.

bodyPlan.rationale: The project's proven primary-plus-additional-limb layout (horse hooves, grizzly bear, owlbear) yields equal primary attacks at full Strength; a secondary-hand slot is not used because the printed routine has no secondary attack.

skillPlan.omissionReason: Kingmaker has no ordinary-map Climb consumer for a summoned unit and merges Climb into Athletics, whose live consumers are not the printed climb. The printed rank that paid for Climb is not reallocated, and Mobility is never inflated to stand in for Climb.
notSubstituted: Mobility is not substituted for Climb.
Athletics is not raised to simulate the +8 racial climb bonus.

specialAttacks.name: rend
specialAttacks.trigger: both claws hit the same target

derivations.attackBonus: BAB +3 plus Strength +4 minus Large size 1 = +6 on the bite and on each claw; all three are primary.
derivations.attackDamage: Full Strength modifier on every limb: bite 1d6+4, each claw 1d4+4 at Strength 19.
derivations.rendDamage: 1d4 plus one and a half times the Strength modifier: 1d4+6 at Strength 19. The multiplier, not the printed constant, is the implementation, so a buffed, enlarged or weakened Dire Ape rends for what its live Strength supports while the printed baseline reproduces 1d4+6 exactly.
derivations.fortitude: Animal 4 HD good Fortitude +4 plus Constitution +3 = +7.
derivations.reflex: Animal 4 HD good Reflex +4 plus Dexterity +2 = +6.
derivations.will: Animal 4 HD poor Will +1 plus Wisdom +1 plus Iron Will +2 = +4.

rendContract.qualifies: Both claws hit the exact same target in the same qualifying attack sequence.
rendContract.emission: Exactly one additional damage event per qualifying sequence, resolved after the second qualifying claw hit.
doesNotQualify: hits in different turns or different commands
critical or on-hit riders replayed to manufacture a second claw hit
rendContract.stateLifetime: No rend tracker may cross commands, targets, turns, save/load, death, dismissal or expiry.
forbidden: No grab, pin or armor-targeting AI is invented merely because the flavour text says Dire Apes may grapple difficult foes.

implementationConsequences: Bite and both claws are primary attacks at the same attack bonus and full Strength.
Rend is the only special attack.
Climb movement is omitted under the ordinary-map land-use scope.
Low-light vision and scent are omitted under OwnerAcceptedEngineLimitation: PASSIVE_CREATURE_SENSES_UNMODELED.

bodyPlan.rationale: Exactly the grizzly bear, dire bear and owlbear layout already runtime-qualified in this project for a bite plus two equal primary claws at full Strength. The native command-level rend gate would instead require one claw in the secondary-hand slot, which cannot express three equal primary attacks and would also rend from a bite-then-claw pair.

skillPlan.omissionReason: Same honest climb omission as the Ape. The printed rank that paid for Climb is not reallocated.
notSubstituted: Mobility is not substituted for Climb.

nativeRendAudit.method: Read-only Mono.Cecil IL inspection of the private compiler-input reference assembly. No game process, no blueprint library and no game data were touched.

nativeDamageCarrier.didTrigger: if (evt.IsRend && evt.AttackRoll.IsHit) { bonus = (int)(Owner.Stats.Strength.Bonus * 1.5); Rulebook.TriggerEvent(new RuleDealDamage(Owner.Unit, evt.Target, RendType.GetDamageDescriptor(RendDamage, bonus).CreateDamage())); }
nativeDamageCarrier.verdict: ADOPTED. The engine's own rend damage event and its exact one-and-a-half Strength derivation are used unchanged.

nativeSequenceGate.observedLogic: HasRend is set AND attack.Hand == Executor.Body.SecondaryHand AND the weapon is not ranged AND LastExecutedAttack != null AND LastExecutedAttack.IsHit AND LastExecutedAttack.Hand == Executor.Body.PrimaryHand.
nativeSequenceGate.alsoDrives: UnitAttack.TryStartNextAttack sets UnitAnimationActionHandle.IsRendAttack from the same gate, so the native rend animation variant is selected by the command-level decision rather than by the rule.
nativeSequenceGate.attackOrder: CreateFullAttack interleaves primary-hand and secondary-hand attacks first, then appends every AdditionalLimbs attack with zero penalty.
nativeSequenceGate.verdict: NOT ADOPTED for the gate. It identifies a rend by hand slot rather than by limb, so it cannot express a bite plus two equal primary claws, it would rend from a bite-then-claw pair whenever the bite sat in the primary hand, and it never checks that the two hits landed on the same target.
nativeSequenceGate.consequence: The native rend attack animation variant is not selected, because it is chosen by the command-level gate. Rend is still a visible damage event on the second qualifying claw hit. This is recorded as an honest presentation deviation, not a mechanical one, and nothing is invented to replace it.

nativeRendAudit.adoptedDesign: A bounded Dire-Ape-owned component replaces exactly one decision - whether this attack is a rend - and then lets the native RendFeature resolve the damage. The component owns no damage math, no global patch and no framework. It is scoped to the exact owning blueprint and its two claw limbs.

donorAndRig.requirement: One bounded read-only primate donor census before either model is authored.

offlinePreCensus.finding: The installed library carries no ape, gorilla, monkey, baboon or other primate unit type, and the audited fact set carries no RendFeature consumer. There is therefore no native primate donor and no native rend creature to clone; both silhouettes must be original project-owned geometry on a non-primate donor rig.

candidateFamilies.why: Large bipedal hunched humanoid with long arms, a bite and claws; closest to both ape silhouettes and to the Dire Ape's bite-and-claw contacts.
Large multi-armed brute; extra arm chain is a deformation risk.
Large quadruped with rearing claw contacts; carries an obvious bear gait the contract forbids.
Large bipedal-leaning bear-shaped rig with claw contacts.

offlinePreCensus.shareDecisionRule: One shared primate rig is preferred only if it credibly supports knuckle locomotion, two-handed slams, Dire Ape bite and claw contacts, and distinct Ape and Dire silhouettes. If it cannot without obvious deformation or a human or bear gait, the two implementations split. Reuse is not forced.

census.method: Detached read-only view prefabs at mod load. No campaign actor spawned, no save read or written, no native asset modified, nothing to clean up.

chosenDonor.why: The only Large surveyed rig actually built like an ape: an upright Pelvis-rooted spine, long two-segment arms ending in real hands with a thumb and three fingers, a separate Jaw_01, and legs with toes. It carries knuckle locomotion and two-handed slams for the Ape and bite and claw contacts for the Dire Ape without a bear or human gait.

rejected: Owlbear (the provisional donor): 29 bones, no hands, no jaw, no toes; a quadruped bear rig.
Athach: 64 bones but Huge and equally handless, rooted at LowerTorso.
Cyclops/HillGiant/FrostGiant: 48-bone upright humanoid, but a human gait and no ape arm length.
UMA human rigs (Wild Hunt, zombies): human gait, explicitly forbidden by the contract.
census.sharedRigDecision: One shared rig for both apes. It credibly supports knuckle locomotion, two-handed slams, and Dire Ape bite and claw contacts, and the two silhouettes are separated by geometry rather than by rig, so reuse is correct here rather than forced.
census.finding: The live library re-confirms no primate unit type and no RendFeature consumer, so both bodies must be original project-owned geometry.

originalBodies.input: One bind-pose skeleton: bone names, bind positions, parent links. No native vertex, index, texture pixel, shader or animation curve is read, and none is redistributed.

ape.features: Near-black silverback: heavy brow, low sagittal crest, broad flat prognathic face, pot belly, nails. No claws and no bared canines, because the printed routine has neither.

direApe.features: Russet Gigantopithecus: bulkier through chest and shoulders, tall sagittal crest, straw-pale shoulder ruff, long canines for the 1d6 bite, heavy curved claws for the two primary 1d4 claw attacks.

emptyDonorBranches.reason: An ape has no tail, and neither printed routine has a tongue attack. The generator, the offline fixtures, the runtime policy and the repository validator each refuse a mesh that weights one of them.

originalBodies.triangleWinding: shared-exporter-sprint18. Verified rather than assumed: the generator computes the signed volume of every connected shell and refuses to export a negative one, and the offline fixtures repeat that check independently.
originalBodies.offlineReview: Twenty-four private sheets per creature: clay, silhouette, textured and unlit at rest from four angles; the forward slam, a synthetic contact frame, the one-armed claw rake and the crouch; a head close-up with the jaw open; and a hand close-up with the fingers curled.
originalBodies.notQualified: Nothing about these bodies is runtime proved. The offline poses are synthetic and prove no timing, no contact point and no in-game behaviour.
originalBodies.acceptedDeviation: The knuckle-walking gait is not authored. The engine plays the donor rig's own clips, which belong to a large upright biped. The geometry is an ape; the locomotion and strike timing are the donor's. A faithful primate gait would be a general animation system, which this sprint does not build.

The 0.0.146 validator freezes src/KingmakerGunslinger/Summoning/, the Expanded Summoning blueprint builders and the shipped creature asset directories against exact commits and asserts sprint18Started == false, so Sprint 18 cannot land under the 0.0.146 record and the version surface must advance with it.

candidateBudget.rule: A retry without a meaningful code or observation-strategy change is not allowed. After two failures of the same requirement, classify it and return a precise blocker.

acceptedEngineLimitations: PASSIVE_CREATURE_SENSES_UNMODELED: low-light vision and scent on both apes.
ORDINARY_MAP_LAND_USE_SCOPE: the 30-foot climb speed and the printed Climb skill on both apes.

measurementConventions.what: Kingmaker puts a Difficulty-descriptor modifier on a non-party creature armour class, from the DifficultOpponent feature the player difficulty setting grants. The third guarded review measured it at -2 on both apes.
measurementConventions.reach: Armour class, touch and flat-footed carry it directly, and the engine computes combat manoeuvre defence from touch armour class, so the same term reaches all four defensive numbers exactly once.
measurementConventions.why it is excluded: The printed stat block describes the creature. The modifier is the player difficulty setting applied to every non-party creature in the game, not anything this sprint does, and it moves with a setting the player owns. The review subtracts it once, records the whole modifier list behind armour class and names the term, so the comparison is to the printed block and the native term stays visible.
measurementConventions.not done: Nothing suppresses, overrides or compensates for the modifier in the game. It applies to both apes exactly as it applies to every other creature at that difficulty.
